$comment: Forge domain verification. Proves that whoever controls furlpay.com is the same party as the GitHub publisher, which is the claim Forge's +5 domain signal makes. Schema per Forge Trust Spec v0.1: the required field is `publisher`, set to the GitHub login/org that publishes the packages. Everything below is descriptive and safe to ignore by a strict parser. NOTE: v0.1 is an open RFC — re-check the field names against the current spec before relying on this, and remember that domain verification proves identity, never code safety.
